articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Audio, Video, and Code
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can process interleaved video, audio, and code inputs in a single context window of up to 1 million tokens. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement over GPT-5 on complex agentic coding tasks, and the model demonstrates near-human performance on novel scientific reasoning challenges. The release intensifies competition with Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2, which launched weeks earlier.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's RT-4 Robot Foundation Model Enables Zero-Shot Task Transfer Across Humanoid Platforms
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled RT-4, a robotics transformer model trained on a massive cross-embodiment dataset spanning over 30 robot form factors. The model achieves zero-shot generalization to unseen humanoid hardware, allowing a policy trained on one platform to execute complex manipulation tasks on another without fine-tuning. This represents a major step toward universal robot foundation models and has drawn significant interest from manufacturing and logistics partners.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Steering: Fine-Grained Runtime Control of LLM Behavior Without Retraining
articles.summary: Anthropic published a research paper and shipped an API feature called Constitutional Steering, which allows developers to dynamically adjust model behavior along interpretable safety and capability axes at inference time without any fine-tuning. The technique builds on their mechanistic interpretability work by identifying and manipulating specific activation directions in the residual stream. Early adopters report significantly reduced need for prompt engineering and custom RLHF runs.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid Workers at BMW Spartanburg Plant
articles.summary: Figure announced the first large-scale commercial deployment of its Figure 03 humanoid robots, with 150 units now operational at BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina manufacturing facility. The robots handle material transport, parts kitting, and quality inspection tasks alongside human workers, operating autonomously for full 8-hour shifts. BMW reports a 22% throughput improvement in the deployed zones, marking a landmark moment for humanoid robotics in real industrial settings.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Behemoth: A 1.2 Trillion Parameter MoE Model Rivaling Closed-Source Leaders
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, a 1.2 trillion parameter mixture-of-experts model that matches or exceeds GPT-5 on most public benchmarks while being fully open-weight under a permissive license. The model uses a novel grouped-query routing mechanism that reduces inference costs by roughly 60% compared to dense models of similar capability. The release has galvanized the open-source AI community and raised fresh regulatory debate in the EU and US Congress.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Chips at Arizona Fab 2
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its second Arizona fabrication facility has entered volume production on the A14 (1.4nm-class) process node using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors. The node delivers a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction over the N2 process, with early customers including Apple and NVIDIA for next-generation AI accelerators. This marks a milestone for advanced semiconductor manufacturing on US soil and a major win for the CHIPS Act initiative.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface with 16,384-Electrode Array
articles.summary: Neuralink announced FDA clearance for its N2 implant, which quadruples the electrode count of its first-generation device to 16,384 channels and introduces bidirectional stimulation capabilities. Early clinical trial participants with spinal cord injuries demonstrated real-time cursor and robotic arm control with latency under 10 milliseconds. The approval opens the door for expanded clinical trials targeting motor restoration and treatment-resistant neurological conditions in 2027.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Toyota Research Institute Unveil Joint Dexterous Manipulation Platform for Home Robotics
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics and the Toyota Research Institute announced a joint venture combining Boston Dynamics' Atlas platform with TRI's diffusion-policy-based manipulation stack to target home assistance use cases. The combined system demonstrated reliable performance on 47 out of 50 household tasks in unstructured environments, including laundry folding, dish loading, and cluttered-surface cleanup. A limited consumer pilot program is planned for late 2027 at a projected price point under $75,000.
